$comment: Node library v1 registry. `baseline` is the line P1a draws: every .mjs already in .clade/work-loop/ on that date is grandfathered, and anything created after it is what audit-flow-nodes.ts reports. `nodes` is the library; `coverage` records how many of the 88 baseline scripts each node was derived from, which is the evidence the selection was empirical rather than assumed.

baseline.note: 88 ad-hoc .mjs in .clade/work-loop/ at the moment P1a landed. The P1 acceptance criterion is five consecutive loop rounds adding zero new ones.

nodes.name: td-rotate
nodes.cluster: TD entries moved to archive, byte-exact

nodes.name: td-inject
nodes.cluster: idempotent block insertion inside one TD entry

nodes.name: td-open
nodes.cluster: mint the next TD number across the live register and every archive
nodes.$comment: coverage 0 on purpose and NOT a gap in the empirical selection: the 88 .mjs corpus is what the loop hand-rolled, and nobody hand-rolls a minter — they read the live register's highest number and add one, which is why TD-660 was opened as a duplicate. The node exists to remove that failure rather than to replace an existing script; td-register-scan's max_td is single-file by design and MUST NOT be used to mint.

nodes.name: json-inspect
nodes.cluster: drill a key path, tally, list outliers

nodes.name: audit-assert
nodes.cluster: run an audit script, compare a field to a baseline

nodes.name: git-provenance
nodes.cluster: did it land / is it an ancestor / what changed since

nodes.name: transcript-scan
nodes.cluster: walk session jsonl with cutoff + regex

nodes.name: commit-only
nodes.cluster: git commit --only plus the three verify layers

nodes.name: worktree-open
nodes.cluster: worktree start predicate as a precondition

nodes.name: worktree-close
nodes.cluster: five-column lifecycle gate as a postcondition

nodes.name: vp-check
nodes.cluster: vp check as a gate node

nodes.name: publish
nodes.cluster: publish with the runner-child guard as a blocked state (§11.2)

nodes.name: propagate
nodes.cluster: propagate with the runner-child guard as a blocked state (§11.2)

nodes.name: ingest-pi-ledger
nodes.cluster: backfill dispatch-ledger rows onto the spine as point events (TD-794 刀 1)
nodes.$comment: coverage 0 on purpose: the 88 .mjs corpus never touched the pi ledger because nothing ever read it back — that blindness is what this node removes, not a cluster it replaces. It is also the one node that emits events it did not itself perform; the library's 「NEVER 自己 emit span」 is about a node recording its OWN execution, and these rows are somebody else's history.

nodes.name: cmd
nodes.cluster: consumer-facing: any project command, with --each fan-out over a git pathspec
nodes.$comment: coverage 0 on purpose and it is NOT a gap in the empirical selection: the 88 .mjs corpus is clade's own loop, and this node exists for the consumer cookbook specs P3 ships, where every step is a project command (pnpm gen:types, supabase db push) that no clade-discipline node covers.

$exempt_comment: Filenames here are excused from the new-.mjs signal. Add one only with a reason a reader can check; an exemption without a stated cause is how a warn-only signal becomes decoration.
